page_title: NAN 0-3 REN | Nantes v Rennes 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Marcus Coco (Nantes) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Desire Doue sprays a pass out to Amine Gouiri (Rennes), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:3.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' PENALTY APPEAL after Desire Doue (Rennes) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Fabian Rieder (Rennes) coming on for Azor Matusiwa.
89' Julien Stephan decides to make a substitution. Jeanuel Belocian will be replaced by Arthur Theate (Rennes).
85' That will be all from Kelvin Amian who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marcus Coco (Nantes).
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

82' Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save. The referee blows his whistle, Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
82' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Martin Terrier is replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Rennes).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amine Gouiri (Rennes) replaces Arnaud Kalimuendo.
79' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

79' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the top left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper. Good work from Nantes as they win a corner.
78' Kader Bamba (Nantes) steps up to send the ball in.

78' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
76' 0 - 2 Goal! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alban Lafont into the top right corner.
76' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
75' Alban Lafont (Nantes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Willy Delajod signals. Rennes have been awarded a penalty kick!
72' Kader Bamba (Nantes) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
72' A substitution has been made. Florent Mollet is replaced by Stredair Appuah (Nantes).
72' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Benie Traore.
71' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul. That's a free kick to Nantes.
69' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
68' Substitution. Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) in, Ludovic Blas out.
67' 0 - 1 Guela Doue feeds the ball through to Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly drills it into the roof of the net! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
63' Guela Doue (Rennes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
60' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Steve Mandanda, who smothers the ball.
58' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Christopher Wooh (Rennes) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads high over the bar from close in.
58' Rennes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

54' Desire Doue (Rennes) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Baptiste Santamaria plays a lovely pass into Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
53' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
52' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) picks up a yellow card.
50' He should have scored! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
48' The free kick is taken by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), but ball is cleared.
47' Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul after Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Rennes in a dangerous position.
46' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Guela Doue (Rennes).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Kader Bamba plays a pass into the path of Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
45+2' Kader Bamba (Nantes) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Desire Doue (Rennes) for his blatant foul.
42' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
41' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
39' Desire Doue (Rennes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
37' Florent Mollet (Nantes) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
36' Total attempts – 2:5. 2:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
34' Desire Doue (Rennes) tries to find Arnaud Kalimuendo, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
33' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' The game is interrupted now, Ludovic Blas (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

31' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Steve Mandanda was alert and the score remains the same.
29' The resulting corner from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
28' Desire Doue (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
28' Desire Doue (Rennes) latches on to a sweet pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a brilliant shot towards the goal, but he hits the crossbar!
26' Antoine Kombouare is forced to make a change. Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Kader Bamba.
25' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
23' Desire Doue (Rennes) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
23' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
21' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
17' Dangerous play by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes). Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
14' The resulting corner, taken by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), comes to nothing.
13' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes the corner but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
13' The free kick from Ludovic Blas (Rennes) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out. Rennes win a corner.

12' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Willy Delajod stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Rennes.
10' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post.
10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
9' Martin Terrier (Rennes) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Rennes earn a corner.
8' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alban Lafont is quickest to intercept the ball.

5' The cross into the penalty area from Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
5' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Moussa Sissoko (Nantes).
1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nantes will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will officiate today.
